sloka: चणकानां कुलित्थानां माषाणां लवणस्य च ।अतो ऽनुरूपं स्नेहं च गन्धं सङ्क्षिप्तमेव च ।। ७.९१.२० ॥
transliteration: caṇakānāṁ kulitthānāṁ māṣāṇāṁ lavaṇasya ca ।ato 'nurūpaṁ snehaṁ ca gandhaṁ saṅkṣiptameva ca ।। 7.91.20 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, suitable oil and collected spices, along with chickpeas, horse gram, black gram, and salt, should also be taken.
